text: 1. Citizens of non-Chinese nationality, aged between 18 and 60, in good physical and mental health and with proper conduct. 2. Should have equivalent educational qualifications to a high school diploma; 3. For international students who are studying the language courses, if they wish to apply for the Chinese language program at our school, they must provide the original certificate of completion and demonstrate an attendance rate of 90% or higher. 4. International students who have already obtained a degree in China are not eligible to apply for this program.
